title: Upcoming IPOs, Explained Simply — July 2026
description: This week, we look at IPOs from Laser Power & Infra Limited and Happy Steels Limited that are closing today. We also preview upcoming IPOs from SBI Funds Mana.

faq.q: How do I even apply for an IPO?
faq.a: You can apply for an IPO through your bank or stockbroker using the ASBA (Application Supported by Blocked Amount) facility. Your application money is blocked in your bank account but only debited if you are allotted shares.
The lot size is the minimum number of shares you must apply for in an IPO. You cannot apply for individual shares; you must bid in multiples of this specified lot.

faq.q: What is the difference between Mainboard and SME IPOs?
faq.a: Mainboard IPOs are for larger, more established companies that list on the main exchanges (NSE, BSE). SME IPOs are for smaller companies, listed on dedicated SME platforms, often with different regulations and trading rules.

faq.q: What happens if an IPO is oversubscribed?
faq.a: If an IPO receives more applications than available shares, it is oversubscribed. For retail investors, shares are usually allotted through a lottery system. If you don't get an allotment, your blocked application money is released back to your account.

faq.q: Can I sell my shares on the first day of listing?
faq.a: Yes, once the shares are officially listed and trading begins on the stock exchange, you are free to sell them at the prevailing market price, just like any other stock.
